headline:
Manufacturing Infrastructure
Advanced extrusion facility at
KINFRA Industrial Park, Kerala
description: Operating within the government-supported KINFRA Industrial Park in Kuttippuram, Kerala, Defenseply's manufacturing plant is equipped with dedicated industrial power and automated extrusion lines. Supported by the AP Group, the facility focuses on the calibrated production of Wood Polymer Composite (WPC) and cellular PVC boards, doors, and profiles engineered for moisture resistance and consistent dimensional stability.
